words.sense: helping treatment or recovery; restoring physical or emotional well-being
misconceptions: Assuming any pleasant relief repairs the underlying cause.
Mistaking symptom relief for recovery of function.

words.sense: relieving distressing symptoms without treating the underlying cause
words.connotation: comfort-focused; not a claim of cure
misconceptions: Thinking all treatment has to cure immediately.

semantic_axes.description: Therapeutic emphasizes treatment or restoration of well-being, while palliative emphasizes easing symptoms without correcting the cause.

edges.boundary_rule: Therapeutic emphasizes treatment or restoration of well-being, while palliative emphasizes easing symptoms without correcting the cause.

misconceptions.M1: Assuming any pleasant relief repairs the underlying cause.
misconceptions.M2: Thinking all treatment has to cure immediately.
misconceptions.M3: Mistaking symptom relief for recovery of function.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Noor's weekly exercises?

beats.text: Noor follows movements that gradually let her injured knee bend farther and support her weight again.
beats.decisive_clue: the movements help her knee regain function
beats.reason: The movements help her knee regain function is the evidence for therapeutic.

beats.text: Over several sessions, she can climb stairs she previously avoided.
beats.reason: Climbing stairs is evidence of functional recovery, not just a brief reduction in discomfort.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: continued exercises restore practical movement.
chains.feedback_deep: Therapeutic activities contribute to treatment and recovery. Noor’s exercises rebuild usable movement; palliative measures would primarily ease symptoms without addressing the problem.
chains.contrast_rule: Therapeutic helps recovery; palliative helps symptoms.

hints.attention: Look for recovery or only a reduction in discomfort.
hints.axis: Therapeutic emphasizes treatment or restoration of well-being, while palliative emphasizes easing symptoms without correcting the cause.
hints.contrast: Therapeutic helps recovery; palliative helps symptoms.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Mateo's cool forehead cloth?

beats.text: Mateo rests a damp cloth on his forehead; the throbbing eases, but the cause of his headache remains unchanged.
beats.decisive_clue: the cloth eases pain without changing its cause
beats.reason: The cloth eases pain without changing its cause is the evidence for palliative.

beats.text: He replaces the cloth whenever the cooling sensation fades.
beats.decisive_clue: temporary comfort remains the only demonstrated effect
beats.reason: Refreshing the cloth extends symptom relief but does not make it a treatment of the cause.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: the cloth eases pain without changing its cause.
chains.feedback_deep: Palliative describes easing symptoms without resolving the underlying condition. Mateo’s cloth comforts him but has no shown effect on the headache’s cause.
chains.contrast_rule: Therapeutic helps recovery; palliative helps symptoms.

hints.attention: Look for recovery or only a reduction in discomfort.
hints.axis: Therapeutic emphasizes treatment or restoration of well-being, while palliative emphasizes easing symptoms without correcting the cause.
hints.contrast: Therapeutic helps recovery; palliative helps symptoms.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Aria's guided recovery programme?

beats.text: Aria learns breathing and coping habits that improve her sleep and help her manage recurring stress.
beats.decisive_clue: the programme improves her lasting well-being
beats.reason: The programme improves her lasting well-being is the evidence for therapeutic.

beats.text: She keeps practising between sessions and notices the improvements last throughout her week.
beats.decisive_clue: sustained well-being remains the main benefit
beats.reason: The extra practice confirms an ongoing restorative benefit rather than a momentary distraction.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: the programme improves her lasting well-being.
chains.feedback_deep: Therapeutic covers treatment and restoration of emotional well-being. Aria develops lasting coping habits, unlike an intervention that only masks immediate symptoms.
chains.contrast_rule: Therapeutic helps recovery; palliative helps symptoms.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Davi's throat lozenge?

beats.text: Davi takes a lozenge that briefly soothes his sore throat while the infection runs its course.
beats.decisive_clue: it eases a sore throat without shortening illness
beats.reason: It eases a sore throat without shortening illness is the evidence for palliative.

beats.text: He knows it does not shorten the illness and takes it mainly to speak comfortably.
beats.decisive_clue: its purpose is comfort rather than treating the infection
beats.reason: The added purpose confirms symptom management without a change to the infection.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: its purpose is comfort rather than treating the infection.
chains.feedback_deep: Palliative relief addresses how an illness feels. Davi’s lozenge makes speaking easier but is not presented as treating the infection.
chains.contrast_rule: Therapeutic helps recovery; palliative helps symptoms.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Esha's hand exercises?

beats.text: Esha practises small daily finger movements to rebuild grip after weeks in a splint.
beats.decisive_clue: the exercises are intended to rebuild grip
beats.reason: The exercises are intended to rebuild grip is the evidence for therapeutic.

beats.text: The exercises are written on a colourful card she keeps beside her bed.
beats.decisive_clue: the original goal of rebuilding grip still determines the choice
beats.reason: A colourful card changes presentation, not the restorative purpose of the exercises.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: the exercises are intended to rebuild grip.
chains.feedback_deep: Therapeutic refers to interventions helping functional recovery. Esha’s goal is stronger grip; the card design has no bearing on that purpose.
chains.contrast_rule: Therapeutic helps recovery; palliative helps symptoms.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Rosa's motion-sickness patch?

beats.text: Rosa wears a patch that reduces nausea during the trip without addressing why motion makes her ill.
beats.decisive_clue: it reduces nausea without addressing the trigger
beats.reason: It reduces nausea without addressing the trigger is the evidence for palliative.

beats.text: The patch keeps working until she reaches her destination, then she removes it.
beats.decisive_clue: its effect lasts only while she wears it
beats.reason: The duration of relief does not turn symptom control into treatment of the cause.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: its effect lasts only while she wears it.
chains.feedback_deep: Palliative measures relieve symptoms even when the underlying condition remains. The patch controls Rosa’s nausea without correcting her susceptibility to motion sickness.
chains.contrast_rule: Therapeutic helps recovery; palliative helps symptoms.
